purpose: Teach: 売り込み/給水/消火/手掛け/綴る/祭祀/即位/レポーター

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、防犯機器、絶対、売り込み、絶対、お受けしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police take crime prevention equipment very seriously. We're genuinely grateful for everything you do.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Steady rhythm without rush. Genuine weight behind each phrase. Professional respect, not performance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察署、本気で、絶対、給水、絶対、設備、絶対、当社、絶対、ご支援、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. And we're equally committed to supporting the police station's water and facility needs. We truly appreciate the partnership.
lines.style: Warm agreement. Slightly more personal than the opening. Lean in on 'committed.' The ease of shared purpose between two people who understand the work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の、本気で、絶対、消火、絶対、訓練、絶対、定期、絶対、実施しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police conduct regular fire safety training and drills. That discipline is something we deeply respect.
lines.style: Calm, precise. Each sentence lands clean. A slight nod of acknowledgment on 'regular.' No rush — the words carry their own weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様が、本気で、絶対、手掛けて、絶対、おられる、絶対、防犯活動、絶対、当社、絶対、ご支援、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The police's crime prevention efforts are something we're proud to support in any way we can.
lines.style: Straightforward, genuine. Slight warm emphasis on 'proud.' No flourish — just clear statement of shared commitment. Eye-contact steady.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、報告書を、絶対、綴る、絶対、業務、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police maintain meticulous documentation on all our operations. That thoroughness sets the standard.
lines.style: Precise, almost deliberate. Slight pause before 'meticulous.' Pride in the detail without being verbose. The tone of someone who knows the work matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の、本気で、絶対、祭祀、絶対、警備、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご対応、絶対、ありがとうございます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Especially during local festivals and community events — we're grateful for how thoroughly the police handle security. Thank you for that.
lines.style: Warm gratitude. Noticeably more personal than before. Slight breathiness on 'thank you.' The shift from formal exchange to genuine thanks.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 新署長の、本気で、絶対、即位、絶対、警察、絶対、結束、絶対、強めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: With our new chief taking the helm, the police force has strengthened its unity. We're seeing real cohesion.
lines.style: Calm authority. Slight lift on 'new chief' — recognition of the transition. Measured pace. The tone of someone reporting genuine improvement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。報道の、本気で、絶対、レポーター、絶対、警察取材、絶対、入っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've also had media coverage of the police's work lately. The attention is well-deserved.
lines.style: Light, closing warmth. Slightly more reflective than earlier. The ease of wrapping up a conversation that mattered. Small smile in the voice.
